{"instruction": "Restore the outer halves of all four arms, extending each back to the full outer length and rebuilding them to full thickness; remove the 45° upward slopes so every arm has a flat underside and constant thickness to the tip.", "original_source": "import math

inner = 10.96
outer = 27.4

result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline([[10.96, 10.96], [27.4, 10.96], [27.4, -10.96], [10.96, -10.96], [10.96, -27.4], [-10.96, -27.4], [-10.96, -10.96], [-27.4, -10.96], [-27.4, 10.96], [-10.96, 10.96], [-10.96, 27.4], [10.96, 27.4]])
    .close()
    .extrude(7.4)
)
wedge_px = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline([(inner, 0.0), (outer, 0.0), (outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
wedge_nx = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline([(-inner, 0.0), (-outer, 0.0), (-outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
wedge_py = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([(inner, 0.0), (outer, 0.0), (outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
wedge_ny = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([(-inner, 0.0), (-outer, 0.0), (-outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
result = result.cut(wedge_px).cut(wedge_nx).cut(wedge_py).cut(wedge_ny)
